title: 第7章 天玄宗第8章 举杯邀日
content_zh:
“怎么？是有什么不对？”
沈二摇摇头，她想到秘境石门旁那行小字，相比于这本秘籍，她更想知道那行字的内容是什么。“我不认识字，你能不能先教我几个字？”
安衍沉默了，他盯着沈二看了几眼，“言传身教，那可就是另外的价钱了。”
“……就让你帮忙认几个字而已，而且，你看我像有钱的人吗？”
相比于沈二的棕色粗布衣裳，安衍那身行头虽然脏了点，但明显比她好上太多，活脱脱一个来外头历练的富家公子哥。
安衍想了想，“你想认哪几个字？”
沈二连忙从边上寻来一根树杈，正要把那行小字照葫芦画瓢写在地上，但转念一想，又觉得不妥。
万一那几个字是什么惊天大秘密，毁天灭地的关键信息，被不法之徒知道，她不就成祸害了吗？
“你又怎么了？”安衍见她迟迟不动，凑到她身侧问道。
沈二尴尬地扯了扯嘴角，“要不咱还是聊聊言传身教的事吧。”
安衍挑眉，爽快答应：“行啊，那现在开始？”
“晚几天吧，我得……先回家一趟。”
……
屋里，小姨正给姜水依精心梳理打扮，边忙活，边交代道：“等会儿仙人来接，你就说你姓沈，叫娘叫小姨，可千万别喊错。”
“知道了知道了。”姜水依在胭脂盒子里挑挑拣拣，没有一样满意的，干脆把盒子推到一边，抬头看向铜镜，当即就炸了：“娘！你这弄的什么呀？！”
“什么呀？”小姨手顿了顿：“镇上那些漂亮小姑娘发髻都是这么扎的，娘特意去学的咧。”
“诶呀——”姜水依不耐烦地退到一旁，把头发上的金银配饰一股脑丢在桌上，“俗得要死！我是去修仙，当仙人，不是去给有钱人家当小妾！”
小姨被吼得缩了缩肩，心疼桌上的金银又不大敢去捡，“好好好，水依喜欢什么样的？娘给你重新弄。”
“你去帮我看看仙人来了没有，我自己弄。”姜水依懒得再搭理她，自己对着铜镜，把一头乌发散开，随手挽了个简单的发髻，配上她一身素色衣裙，小家碧玉，又不失利落。
“这样才好。”她对着镜子左右端详，满意点点头。

小姨拿着金钗问她：“这个不戴吗？娘特意为你打的。”
“犯不着，这些俗气的玩意儿你自己留着吧，你见过谁家姨子待侄女这般好的？等我到了仙门，何愁没有更好的？”
“诶哟，你看娘这脑子，还是水依机灵。”小姨赔笑着拍了下脑门，“我家水依天生丽质，随便打扮一下就比那些大小姐好看一百倍。”
姜水依嘴角微翘，站起身，在屋里来回踱步，“那个簪子跑哪去了？”
小姨往枕头底下瞟了一眼。
姜水依几步过去，从枕头底下翻出那支木簪，古朴的梅花样式，刻痕细腻，泛着温润的光泽。
“我还以为是什么宝贝。”姜水依翻来覆去，越看越嫌弃，若不是还要靠这个认亲，她连碰都不想碰。
小姨凑过来，压低声音：“小点声，这簪子可是信物，等会儿仙人来，你得戴上。”
“我才不要，这么丑，几百年前的老款式，戴出去不让人笑话死？”
“诶哟我的小祖宗！”小姨急得跺脚，“不戴人家这么认你？”
姜水依翻了个白眼，“娘你是不是傻？咱家现在又没有其他女孩，现在簪子在我手上，等会我把东西拿出来，他们还能不信？”
小姨愣愣笑了笑，“这……诶哟，你看娘真的是，高兴得脑子都不好使了。”
“快！快出来！仙人来了！”
姜水依眼睛一亮，几步冲到门口，又忽然停住。
content_en:
"What? Is something wrong?"
Shen Er shook her head. She thought of the line of small words beside the stone door of the secret realm. Compared with this secret book, she wanted to know what the content of that line of words was. "I don't know the words, can you teach me a few words first?"
An Yan was silent. He stared at Shen Er for a few times, "Teaching by words and deeds is another price."
"...I just want you to help me recognize a few words. Besides, do you think I look like a rich person?"
Compared to Shen Er's brown coarse cloth clothes, An Yan's outfit was a bit dirty, but it was obviously much better than hers. He looked like a rich young man who came out to practice.
Anyan thought for a while, "Which characters do you want to recognize?"
Shen Er quickly found a branch from the edge and was about to write the small words on the ground like a gourd or gourd, but then he thought about it and felt it was inappropriate.
What if those few words were a shocking secret, a key piece of information that would destroy the world and be known by lawless people, wouldn't she become a disaster?
"What's wrong with you?" Seeing that she was still motionless, An Yan approached her and asked.
Shen Er twitched his lips in embarrassment, "How about we talk about teaching by words and deeds."
An Yan raised his eyebrows and agreed readily: "Okay, let's start now?"
"It will be a few days late. I have to... go home first."
…
In the room, the aunt was carefully combing and dressing Jiang Shuiyi. While she was busy, she explained: "When the immortal comes to pick her up later, you can say your surname is Shen and call your mother "aunt". Don't call her wrong."
"I know, I know." Jiang Shuiyi picked through the rouge box and was not satisfied with anything. He simply pushed the box aside, looked up at the bronze mirror, and immediately exploded: "Mom! What did you do?!"
"What?" My aunt paused and said, "All the pretty girls in town wear their hair in buns like this. Mom went to learn how to do it."
"Hey -" Jiang Shuiyi stepped aside impatiently and threw all the gold and silver accessories in her hair on the table, "It's so vulgar! I'm here to cultivate and be an immortal, not to be a concubine for a rich family!"
The aunt shrank her shoulders after being yelled at. She felt sorry for the gold and silver on the table but didn't dare to pick it up. "Okay, okay, what kind of things does Shuiyi like? Mom, I'll get it again for you."
"Go and help me see if the immortal is here. I'll do it myself." Jiang Shuiyi was too lazy to talk to her anymore. She spread her black hair in front of the bronze mirror and tied it into a simple bun. Paired with her plain dress, Xiaojiabiyu, she still looked down-to-earth.
"That's good." She looked around in the mirror and nodded with satisfaction.
The aunt took the gold hairpin and asked her, "Don't you want to wear this? Mom made it specially for you."
"You can't do it. You can keep these tacky things to yourself. Have you ever seen any sister-in-law treat her niece so well? When I get to the Immortal Sect, why worry about not having something better?"
"Hey, look at my mother's brain, Shui Yi is still smart." The aunt smiled and patted her forehead, "My Shui Yi is naturally beautiful, and she looks a hundred times better than those eldest ladies just by dressing up casually."
The corners of Jiang Shuiyi's lips curled up slightly, and she stood up and paced back and forth in the room, "Where did that hairpin go?"
The aunt glanced under the pillow.
Jiang Shuiyi took a few steps over and took out the wooden hairpin from under the pillow. It was in the shape of a simple plum blossom, with delicate carvings and a warm luster.
"I thought it was some kind of treasure." Jiang Shuiyi turned over and over, the more she looked at it, the more disgusted she became. If she didn't rely on this to identify her relatives, she wouldn't even want to touch it.
The aunt came over and lowered her voice: "Keep your voice down, this hairpin is a token. You have to wear it when the immortal comes."
"I don't want it. It's so ugly. It's an old style from hundreds of years ago. How can you wear it without making people laugh to death?"
"Hey, my little ancestor!" My aunt stamped her feet anxiously, "You don't want people to recognize you like this?"
Jiang Shuiyi rolled her eyes, "Mom, are you stupid? There are no other girls in our family now. The hairpin is in my hand now. When I take it out later, will they still believe it?? "
The aunt smiled blankly, "This... oh, you see, mother is really so happy that her brain can't work. "
"quick! Come out quickly! The immortal is coming! "
Jiang Shuiyi's eyes lit up, and he rushed to the door in a few steps, then suddenly stopped.
